common.aboutp1: Senior backend engineer focused on business-critical systems, APIs, and maintainable delivery. I work well with distributed teams and written-first collaboration.
common.aboutp2: From stabilizing legacy to shipping tested changes: DDD-style boundaries, Cypress/BDD where it counts, CI/CD, and clear handoffs so you are not chasing status.
common.aboutp3: To get started, an email with context is enough; I adapt to your tools and how your team works.
common.about_rich:
Passionate about software architecture, I help businesses and technical teams stabilize their critical systems. Async-first by default: tickets, documented decisions, and pull requests; short syncs when it matters. Backend rigor and transparent communication so distance and time zones are not a blocker.

✅ Specialized in designing resilient systems, I work on legacy to stabilize, APIs to consolidate, or teams to level up: performance optimization (prefetch, bulk, caching), E2E testing (Cypress, BDD). Documented methodology, from design to deployment.
💻 Architecture & Backend: Durable architectures (DDD, APIs, system integration). Targeted refactoring for maintainability and scalability.
🔌 APIs & Integration: API design and hardening, system interconnection, data consistency.
🔧 Technical debt & Performance: Debt reduction, query/prefetch/bulk optimization, caching strategies.
🧪 Quality & delivery: E2E testing (Cypress), BDD scenarios, CI/CD pipelines. Critical paths covered, regressions under control.
🌐 Infra & deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD: controlled, reproducible environments.
💬 Let's discuss your next project: reliability, added value, or quality uplift.
